title: [Bug] RDP connections resolution/sizing does not work correctly
author: sassy-lily
body_snippet:
I'm using nightly build 3725 using the binaries provided in the assets of the release.

I'm using the application to manage RDP connections only.

When I connect to an RDP server:

- if I set the "Resolution" property to "SmartSize" the connection is pretty much unreadable because the remote computer sets an absurdly high resolution which then gets shrunk down and stretched - I don't know which resolution exactly because when I try to check it in Windows all options are disabled and empty, thus ...
